comments.text:
Hey Rey,
I am building AI Accounting Copilot for Chartered Accountant Firms (India)

The problem: Small and mid-size CA firms each handle hundreds of MSME clients. Every month their staff manually match GST returns against purchase registers, chase clients for missing invoices, reconcile bank statements, and fix mismatches before filing deadlines. The work is repetitive and deadline-bound, and it's hard to staff because junior accountants leave often.

The solution: A platform built for the CA firm, It:

	•	takes in client data as it actually arrives: Tally exports, Excel sheets, PDF invoices, bank statements
	•	automatically reconciles purchase records against the GST portal's supplier data and flags mismatches
	•	drafts client follow-up messages on WhatsApp or email for missing documents
	•	shows the firm one dashboard of every client's filing status
